---
title: "Census Maps"
---

Explore how Florida's county populations changed over the decade. The map and
chart below compare population growth from 2010 to 2020.

## Florida county population growth, 2010–2020

::: {.map-instructions}
**Interactive map:** Hover over a county to see its population growth, 2020
population, median age, and median household income. County colors show
population growth from 2010 to 2020.
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidycensus)
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
library(ggplot2)

population_2010 <- get_decennial(
  geography = "county",
  state = "FL",
  variables = "P001001",
  year = 2010
) |>
  transmute(GEOID, population_2010 = value)

population_2020 <- get_decennial(
  geography = "county",
  state = "FL",
  variables = "P1_001N",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
) |>
  transmute(GEOID, NAME, population_2020 = value, geometry)

county_details <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "FL",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    median_income = "B19013_001"
  ),
  year = 2020
) |>
select(GEOID, variable, estimate) |>
tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)

county_map <- population_2020 |>
  left_join(population_2010, by = "GEOID") |>
  left_join(county_details, by = "GEOID") |>
  mutate(
    growth_pct = (population_2020 / population_2010 - 1) * 100,
    hover_text = paste0(
      NAME,
      " | Growth: ", round(growth_pct, 1), "%",
      " | 2020 population: ", format(population_2020, big.mark = ","),
      " | Median age: ", round(median_age, 1),
      " | Median household income: $", format(median_income, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
    )
  )

growth_colors <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "YlOrRd",
  domain = county_map$growth_pct
)

leaflet(county_map) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~growth_colors(growth_pct),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    label = ~hover_text,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#333333",
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = growth_colors,
    values = ~growth_pct,
    title = "Population growth (%)",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```

## Top 5 fastest-growing counties

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

county_map |>
  slice_max(growth_pct, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(NAME, growth_pct), y = growth_pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#e76f51") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Population growth (%)",
    title = "Florida counties with the greatest population growth",
    subtitle = "2010–2020"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Top 2 counties with the least growth

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.5

county_map |>
  slice_min(growth_pct, n = 2, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(NAME, growth_pct), y = growth_pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#457b9d") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Population growth (%)",
    title = "Florida counties with the least population growth",
    subtitle = "2010–2020"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

::: {.data-note}
**Data:** Population counts are from the 2010 and 2020 decennial Censuses.
Median age and median household income are 2020 ACS 5-year estimates.
:::
